children: UK distribution and services group's H1 revenue grew 3% yr/yr, supported by volume and inflation
Adjusted EPS for H1 rose 11.4% yr/yr, driven by margin expansion and operational improvements
Company announced new £500 mln share buyback program to be completed over next 12 months
Bunzl upgrades 2026 outlook, sees modest underlying revenue growth supported by some inflation
Company expects 2026 operating margin to be broadly flat year-on-year versus 7.6% in 2025
Bunzl expects modest adjusted operating profit growth for 2026 at constant exchange rates
VOLUME GROWTH - Co said underlying revenue growth was led by volume increases, especially in North America Distribution
INFLATION IMPACT - Product cost increases, particularly in plastic-related categories, contributed to revenue and margin expansion, though much is expected to be temporary
OPERATIONAL IMPROVEMENTS - Restored service levels and agility in North America Distribution supported financial performance
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 8 "hold" and 4 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the diversified industrial goods wholesale peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Bunzl plc is GBp2,650.00, about 5.1% below its August 28 closing price of GBp2,792.00
The stock recently traded at 15 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
